On Tue, Oct 18, 2016 at 9:09 AM, Jafar Basha Shaik <jafar...@gmail.com> wrote:
I've noticed that if you have both UI and Server functions in the same R script then adding image to the shiny app doesn't work no matter what functions or arguments passed to "img". If UI and Server were split into separate files then there's no issue adding an image to the app. Did anybody else encountered such behavior in Shiny before? Can anybody suggest me a solution to add image when both UI and Server are written in the same R script?

Regards,

Jafar
